title: ANZCA SAQ Syntopical Model-Answer Factory
constraints: Start with dry-run previews and explicit validation gates
Promote safety rules into executable DAG nodes, not prose-only constraints
Preserve user data surfaces: do not mutate vaults, trackers, or remote systems until dry-run plans pass
Emit machine-readable artifacts agents can resume
Every high-risk write, sync, or release node must declare observable acceptance criteria

metadata.outcome: Examiner-fit answer sets with explicit dry-run, evidence, citation, regression, and replay gates

nodes.title: Resolve SAQ batch and canonical vault paths
nodes.content: Input AP/CP question IDs are resolved to canonical MAK95 note paths, existing model-answer destinations, and validator expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Every requested SAQ maps to exactly one source note or emits an ambiguity report
Output paths follow existing model-answer-set conventions

nodes.title: Inspect non-mutating project preview
nodes.content: Run the DAG in dry-run mode and verify planned AoT/br/Linear actions are non-mutating before retrieval or writing.
acceptanceCriteria: Dry-run output has schemaVersion and runId
No vault, tracker, or remote mutation occurs

nodes.title: Retrieve PEX, PageIndex, and vault evidence
nodes.content: Run PEX scope/examiner/brief/layers, PageIndex source orientation, Enzyme/vault retrieval, and local textbook import lookups.
acceptanceCriteria: Evidence bundle names examiner comments, learning objectives, recurring domains, and source anchors

nodes.title: Build machine-readable evidence manifest
nodes.content: Persist source paths, PageIndex anchors, PEX commands, retrieval timestamps, and confidence/review status.
acceptanceCriteria: Manifest includes source path, command, anchor, confidence, and review status for each evidence item

nodes.title: Derive answer route and mark allocation
nodes.content: Convert evidence into route primitives, mark budget, examiner traps, and 8-minute answer shape.
acceptanceCriteria: Route/audit signals are explicit enough for validate_answer_markdown.py

nodes.title: Generate model answer set
nodes.content: Write model-answer-set markdown with source wikilinks, BORROW, answer, examiner-fitness audit, defect class, regression note, and reviewer sign-off.
acceptanceCriteria: Every claim has source support or is marked as synthesis
Answer fits 8-minute shape
Mark allocation is visible
Obsidian wikilinks are preserved

nodes.title: Audit citations, wikilinks, and unsupported claims
nodes.content: Check source anchors, Obsidian wikilinks, hallucinated citations, and unsupported answer claims.
acceptanceCriteria: No broken source anchors
No unresolved wikilinks
Unsupported claims are fixed or flagged

nodes.title: Run answer validator and coverage audit
nodes.content: Run the MAK95 answer validator and coverage checks before any tracker sync.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator passes
No source phase files or coverage ledgers are mutated unless explicitly requested

nodes.title: Compare against known good answer patterns
nodes.content: Compare structure and examiner-fitness signals against prior validated model-answer sets.
acceptanceCriteria: Regression comparison is recorded
Material deviations are justified

nodes.title: Perform independent reviewer sign-off
nodes.content: Separate generation from educational-quality review and record reviewer verdict.
acceptanceCriteria: Reviewer verdict is pass, revise, or reject with reasons

nodes.title: Approve replay or tracker sync
nodes.content: Only after all validation gates pass may the agent replay without dry-run or sync br/Linear.
acceptanceCriteria: Human or policy approval is explicit
Dry-run target set is unchanged

nodes.title: Preserve reasoning graph and failed-run diagnostics
nodes.content: Export AoT atoms, dry-run/replay outputs, validation logs, and failed-run diagnostics as audit trail.
acceptanceCriteria: Includes run ID, source paths, command, validator status, failed-run diagnostics, and artifact hashes

edges.description: canonical path resolution constrains evidence retrieval
answer route must be anchored in recorded evidence
mark allocation and examiner traps constrain answer shape
only passing validation permits replay or external sync
